title: Two-layer quality control protects Arabidopsis from transcriptional errors under heat stress
content: As the world warms up due to climate change, record-shattering heatwaves have scorched many parts of the world, causing the death of thousands of people (Witze 2022). Extreme heat events also pose a threat to plant viability and agriculture. Plants must engage robust resilience mechanisms, including maintaining transcription fidelity, as faulty transcripts can lead to detrimental protein production.
